thread:
marta (customer): hey @support, since ~06:30 UTC we're getting lots of 400s from the /v1/rerank endpoint. nothing changed on our side except a small client update. example response: `400 Bad Request` with body `{\"error\":\"invalid_request\",\"message\":\"Invalid rerank payload\"}`. can someone help?

marta (customer): curl we send (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"queries":{"query":"find best answer"},"candidates":[]}'
```

lee (support): thanks @marta, can you paste the exact payload (looks like candidates is empty) and one full response with headers (request-id if present)? also which client/version? :wave:

marta (customer): request-id header from one failed call: `rq_01Gzzzzzz`
client: our node sdk v0.8.3 (we rolled it at 06:10 UTC). full body above is exact. we do have some cases where candidates array could be empty if upstream search returns none.

jamal (eng): digging in. quick note: the rerank endpoint expects `queries` to be an array of query objects and `candidates` to be a non-empty array of candidate objects/strings depending on mode. If clients send object instead of array or an empty candidates array, validator returns 400. we should improve message but this is working-as-intended for now.

jamal (eng): repro locally with Marta's payload:
```json
{
  "queries": { "query": "find best answer" },
  "candidates": []
}
```
server log excerpt: `ValidationError: candidates: must be non-empty array at request body`

jamal (eng): proposed quick fixes: 1) client-side guard to ensure `queries` is array and `candidates` length > 0; 2) server patch to return more descriptive error (include field path and expected type/constraints); 3) relaxed option: allow empty candidates to return 200 with empty ranking (but that has UX implications).

lee (support): marta — short-term workaround: update client call to wrap query in array and skip calling rerank when candidates.length === 0. example: `if (!Array.isArray(payload.queries)) payload.queries = [payload.queries]; if (payload.candidates.length === 0) return [] // skip request`

marta (customer): ok we'll patch client to guard. any ETA on server-side error clarity? the ambiguous message caused our alerting to fire.

jamal (eng): opening a tiny PR to improve the 400 payload with `field`, `issue`, and `hint`. will roll to canary today. PR: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/repo/pulls/1427 (internal link).

deploy-bot: deploy started for service=rerank-validator branch=jamal/400-improved-errors to=canary
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded service=rerank-validator env=canary sha=abc123 :white_check_mark:

jamal (eng): canary shows enriched error body now for malformed requests, example response:
```json
{
  "error": "invalid_request",
  "field": "candidates",
  "issue": "must be non-empty array",
  "hint": "skip calling /v1/rerank when no candidates are available or provide at least one candidate"
}
```

nina (product): thanks for the quick turnaround. do we need to update docs/SDK? we should add a note to rerank best practices: server expects arrays and will return 400 on empty candidates. also flag whether this is a breaking change for existing clients (I think not, but docs will help).

lee (support): marking ticket P2 since client update mitigates and server now clearer. will follow up with a short KB article and example code. tagging @marta when KB is live. :thumbsup:

marta (customer): really appreciate the quick action. we'll ship client guard in next patch and monitor. thanks team.

jamal (eng): follow-up: we also noticed some older SDKs sent `queries` as an object; added a deprecation header in canary for a week to alert users before rolling to prod.

lee (support): closing thread when KB link posted. thanks all.
